text:
maria: Heads-up team — MidCap (enterprise prospect) wants a POC focused on bursty inference patterns. Requirements from AE: sustained 200 qps for 5m, occasional microbursts up to 1k qps for 20–30s, p95 latency target <350ms for 512-token generation, and a short security questionnaire answered by EOD. Can we draft a load plan + quick cost/infra notes?
li: I can own the load plan. Quick Q: are they using chat (system+user) or plain text-gen? affects token counts.
akshay: For perf we should assume text-gen with ~512 output + ~50 input tokens to be conservative. That makes end-to-end = ~562 tokens, so batching and kv-cache sizing matters.
maria: confirmed with AE — single-turn text-gen, customer will send 1 request per user, no streaming. They care about tail latency spikes during bursts.
li: Proposed run plan:
- Stage 1: Smoke (10 qps for 5m) validate correctness
- Stage 2: Sustained (200 qps for 10m) observe thermal behaviour
- Stage 3: Burst sweeps (500 qps, 750 qps, 1k qps) 30s each, 2x repeats
- Stage 4: Soak (200 qps for 1h) if we pass earlier stages
I'll script with k6 + dynamic payloads. Example k6 snippet:```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://redwood.example/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: '...'}), {headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN'}});
}
```
akshay: Add KV cache warmup phase (prefix cache) — send a few long sequences so model populates cache. Also we should pin a model variant (float16 quant) for predictability.
jordan_sec: Security notes — they require TLS mutual auth for the POC, and confirmation that KMS keys remain customer-owned for Private/Dedicated options. Can we provide a short statement? Also need to know if logs will contain prompt text (PII risk).
li: For the POC host we'll run on our Dedicated pool (customer-facing performance numbers). We can enable mTLS on the endpoint and redact logs. I'll draft a one-paragraph answer for the questionnaire.
maria: Cost ask from buyer: rough monthly price if they run steady 200 qps in prod. Not exact quote, but want order of magnitude to compare.
akshay: Back-of-envelope: 200 qps sustained @ avg 562 tokens => 200 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 * 562 tokens/month ≈ 1.8e11 tokens/month (~180B). If we charge per 1M tokens, that scales — I'll convert to compute equivalent: roughly X dedicated GPU hours; will follow up with numbers once I map tokens -> throughput on our instance types.
li: For the POC itself (few hours of testing) estimate: 4–8 GPU-hours for the Dedicated pool run depending on packing and sequence length. Cost to customer for POC (pass-through) ~ ~$300–$1200 for cloud infra + Redwood engineering support.
maria: Ops question — need a scheduled window with customer for bursts. Can we offer next Tue or Wed? Prefer after-hours to avoid noisy shared infra.
ops-bot: Test environment provisioned: env-midcap-poc-170050 created on dedicated pool size=2, region=us-west-2. CI job triggered: perf-smoke-170050.
akshay: Confirming I'll monitor GPU utilization, queue depth, and latencies. I'll add metrics dashboards and an alert if p95 > 400ms.
jordan_sec: For the questionnaire — I'll write: 1) mTLS supported, 2) KMS integrations available and can be customer-managed for Private, 3) Logs can be redacted and retained per request, 4) We can run contractual SOC2 terms in the POC as a temporary addendum. Will send text in thread.
li: One operational blocker: their SecOps insists on outbound IP allowlist. Need static egress IP range for our Dedicated pool in us-west-2. Ops, can we provide?
akshay: We can provide the current NAT pool (12.34.56.0/28) as static for POC. If they require strict IP, confirm with network team — might take a few hours.
maria: Great. Next steps: li to finalize k6 script + runbook, akshay to prepare dashboards and cost mapping, jordan_sec to paste questionnaire answers, ops to confirm NAT IP range to customer. I'll send calendar invite after li confirms Wed/Thu availability. Thx :thumbsup:
li: Ack — will post the k6 repo link and a short runbook here when ready. Target to post before EOD PST.
